## Summary

Describe the user-visible or maintainer-visible outcome.

## Validation

- [ ] `bun run audit`
- [ ] `bun run format:check`
- [ ] `bun run lint`
- [ ] `bun run typecheck`
- [ ] `bun run test`
- [ ] `bun run build`

List any additional manual or deployment validation.

## Safety and scope

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private keys, private repository data, or personal data are included.
- [ ] Documentation and `TODO.md` are updated when the product contract changed.
- [ ] Authentication, organization, GitHub, and moderation changes include authorization tests.
- [ ] The change remains inside the standalone Plugins platform boundary.
